computation_or_rationale: ASC 105-10-05-2: if authoritative GAAP does not specify guidance, first consider principles for similar transactions within authoritative GAAP, then nonauthoritative sources. IFRS and industry practice are nonauthoritative (105-10-05-3); SABs are SEC staff guidance for registrants only.
Deliberate bias toward the high end 'to be safe' = conservatism/prudence, which violates neutrality (CON 8 QC14, BC3.27-3.29). Not a timeliness/comparability/verifiability problem.

A board plan/intention with no contract or transaction creates no present right or present obligation (CON 8 Ch.4 asset/liability definitions); nothing recognized; disclose commitments only if significant.

ASC 105-10-05-1: the Codification is the source of authoritative nongovernmental GAAP. Concepts Statements nonauthoritative; ASUs are transient documents that amend the Codification; Reg S-X is SEC (registrants only).
GASB sets GAAP for state and local governments (counties). FAF oversees but does not set; FASB = nongovernmental; FASAB = federal.
'When first records' = recognition = Section 25 (842-20-25-1: at commencement recognize ROU asset and lease liability). -30 initial measurement; -35 subsequent measurement; -50 disclosure.
Using current results to confirm/correct prior expectations = confirmatory value (CON 8 QC9). Predictive value = input to forecasting; verifiability is enhancing, not a relevance component.
Fundamental: relevance, faithful representation. Enhancing: comparability, verifiability, timeliness, understandability. (b) reversed order; (c) conservatism not a QC; (d) both enhancing.

Prepaid rent (Dec 1 for Jan-Mar) = present right to future use of property already paid for -> asset. (a) unperformed executory contract generally not recognized; (b) workforce and (c) internally generated reputation not recognized/no controlled right.

Cash received for services not yet provided = present obligation to transfer services = liability (contract liability/unearned revenue, ASC 606). Not revenue until performance; not a gain; not equity (customer is not an owner).
CON 8 QC11: materiality is an entity-specific aspect of relevance based on nature and/or magnitude; no uniform quantitative threshold. Not an enhancing characteristic.

ASC 205-40-50-1: evaluate whether substantial doubt exists within one year after the date the financial statements are issued (or available to be issued). (a) is the IFRS / old period; (b),(c) not the standard.

PCC accounting alternatives (e.g., goodwill amortization, ASC 350-20-15-4) are available only to private companies (and NFPs), i.e., not to public business entities. FASB, not SEC, endorses them; goodwill not generally amortized; PCC alternatives cover recognition/measurement too.

CON 8 QC15: free from error = no errors/omissions in the description and the process selected and applied without error; does not mean perfectly accurate. Later settlement difference does not make the estimate unfaithful.
CON 8 OB2: primary users = existing and potential investors, lenders and other creditors. Management, regulators, public are not primary users.
Fundamental QCs = relevance and faithful representation. Comparability, verifiability, timeliness, understandability are enhancing.
